name: serverBound
detailed_description:
The internet is breaking. Bots infiltrate online communities, corrupting conversations, stealing data, and isolating humans behind walls of spam and deception. You are an Admin (or maybe a normal user), the guardian of your server, wielding the power of network security to fight back.

serverBound is a 1v1 turn-based RPG where every battle is a tactical puzzle. Attack, defend, and exploit cyber vulnerabilities in a combat system, where every move shifts the flow of battle.

Key Features:

💾 Tactical Cyber Battles – Analyze enemy bots, uncover their weaknesses, and counter their attack vectors using a unique affinity-based combat system rooted in real cybersecurity concepts.

🌐 Think Like a Hacker – Gather intel, trace digital footprints, and exploit weak spots in your enemies' defenses. Every fight is a battle of logic and strategy.

🖥️ A Digital World Under Siege – Explore online spaces, interact with human users, and solve problems that range from phishing scams to rogue malware infestations.

🔍 Uncover the Truth – Why are these bots attacking? Who is behind the breaches? Connect with real people behind the screens and dive into a deeper story of digital connection, loneliness, and control.

Are you ready to reclaim the internet?

short_description: Face off in strategic, turn-based battles against bots that exploit vulnerabilities in your community. Unravel the mysteries behind these attacks, connect with the humans at risk, and safeguard the digital realm in serverBound—an investigative RPG that transforms cybersecurity into an epic adventure

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 3 3300X or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or better)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
